title: ArtifactRef/v1
description: A portable, content-addressed reference to an SRL artifact. The digest is authoritative; the optional path is a repo-relative hint. Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

media_type.description: IANA-style media type of the referenced payload (e.g. application/json).

digest.description: Content digest: sha256 + 64 lowercase hex digits. Lowercase-only for byte-stable identity.

size_bytes.description: Non-negative integer byte count of the referenced payload. bool is rejected by the runtime validator even though JSON Schema models bool as an int.

path.description: Optional portable repo-relative path to the bytes. Must be relative, no '..', no drive letter, no leading '/', no backslash. The digest remains authoritative.
